credit_score.disclaimer: Elena's below-average band does not indicate bad financial behavior or defaults—it reflects an unestablished credit file with zero credit history. Australian credit scoring requires active credit facilities to register positive CCR data.

key_insights.title: Unestablished Credit Footprint (Thin File)
key_insights.summary: You have zero credit accounts, loans, or postpaid facilities registered with Australian credit bureaus.
key_insights.bureau_explanation: Under the Australian Credit Reporting Privacy Code, credit bureaus calculate scores based on repayment history, active accounts, and age of file. Without an active facility, automated credit assessments assign a default entry-tier rating regardless of your salary.

key_insights.title: Substantial Liquidity & Savings Buffer ($12,000+)
key_insights.summary: Monthly salary deposits of $7,150 from Canva and $2,500/month recurring savings transfers.
key_insights.bureau_explanation: While pure savings are not visible on an Equifax file, Westpac internally recognizes this as high-tier customer stability, allowing pre-qualification for beginner credit products without manual paperwork.

key_insights.title: 100% On-Time Rental & Tenancy History
key_insights.summary: Flawless fortnightly rental payments of $1,400 to Ray White across 6 consecutive payment dates.
key_insights.bureau_explanation: Private rent is not yet ingested by Australian bureaus, but Westpac Open Banking (CDR) and internal statements can package this as proof of financial reliability for future credit applications.

key_insights.title: $250 Energy Security Deposit Paid Upfront
key_insights.summary: You paid a $250 security deposit to Origin Energy because you lacked local credit history.
key_insights.bureau_explanation: Utility providers routinely waive or refund security deposits once a customer establishes 3 months of uninterrupted direct debits or links an established bank account.

recommended_goals.title: Establish First Credit Footprint (Starter Card + Auto-Pay)

recommended_goals.title: Build an On-Time Bills Record
